title: Kids Creation Stations

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: Get ready for a summer full of creativity and fun in Tampa. At Kids Creation Stations, children ages 5 and up enjoy daily art projects, group games, and movie days complete with popcorn and cotton candy. Families join us for a camp experience filled with painting, crafts, STEM projects, and DIY fun. Every day sparks imagination in a safe, supportive environment where kids make memories that last all summer long. Dive into a week of ocean-themed art adventures! Kids will create deep-sea creatures, mini submarines, research journals, and more while exploring the wonders of the underwater world. Perfect for all ages!
